caption: The drawing features a single object at the center of a blank background. The object is an outlined, upright figurine rendered in black ink or pencil on off-white or light beige paper. The figurine depicts a standing human figure, oriented in profile facing left, with detailed features including a hat with a prominent plume, a coat, and boots. The figure stands atop a rounded base that features swirling, decorative elements. The drawing is composed with the object centered on the page, leaving considerable empty space around it. In the lower left corner, there is a handwritten signature. There is no use of color within the outlined figure; the drawing consists solely of fine, monochrome line work.
title: Statuette
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
